title: Style reference
intro: A visual index of the colors, type, controls, surfaces, diagrams, and motion used across this portfolio. Examples follow the active theme.

colors.title: Color system
colors.description: Warm technical paper and dark ink anchor both themes. Blue carries primary interaction; orange, yellow, red, and green mark supporting signals.

type.title: Type hierarchy
type.description: Expressive, tightly tracked headings pair with readable body copy and compact monospaced instrument labels.

controls.title: Buttons and states
controls.description: Controls use compact uppercase labels, clear focus outlines, and a small accent rail for feedback.

surfaces.title: Cards and surfaces
surfaces.description: Flat panels with restrained 4px corners rely on thin borders and surface contrast instead of heavy shadows.

graphics.title: Technical graphics
graphics.description: Orbital paths, grids, signal bars, and simple schematics add an aerospace character while keeping information legible.

motion.title: Motion and layout
motion.description: Motion stays brief and purposeful. Layouts use the shared content width and MUI spacing scale, adapting to narrow screens.
